table.name: vtiger_user_branch_map
table.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vtiger_user_branch_map` ( `user_id` INT(11) NOT NULL, `parent_user_id` INT(11) DEFAULT NULL, `partner_id` INT(11) NOT NULL, `status` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`), KEY `idx_partner` (`partner_id`), KEY `idx_parent` (`parent_user_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
